entities.description: The bat is a symbol of ill omen in Western tasseomancy, associated with hidden dangers, obstacles in the dark, and the reversal of plans. Near the rim it warns of immediate difficulties approaching from an unseen quarter, often suggesting a betrayal or project that will not proceed as planned. Near the base it points to deep-seated fears or long-standing obstacles that must be confronted before true progress is possible.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Obstacles, hidden dangers, bad omens
extendedData.nearRim: Difficulties approaching; plans may be disrupted by unseen forces
extendedData.nearBase: Deep-seated fears or old obstacles resurfacing

entities.description: The bear in tasseomancy carries a dual nature, representing both raw strength and brute danger. A bear facing the handle suggests a powerful ally or a strong-willed person in the querent's circle; facing away it may indicate a stubborn adversary or one's own inflexibility causing problems. Near the rim it urges caution in dealings with domineering individuals, while near the base it may indicate a long period of enforced patience before matters resolve.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Strength, stubbornness, a powerful force
extendedData.nearRim: A dominant person or force nearby; proceed with caution
extendedData.nearBase: A period of waiting; strength building in reserve

entities.description: Birds are among the most classical messengers in tasseomancy, traditionally bringing news from afar. A bird in flight toward the handle signifies good news coming to the querent directly, while a bird flying away suggests news travelling outward or an opportunity departing. Near the rim a bird promises swift tidings, often happy ones; near the base a perched or downward-angled bird may indicate delayed news or a journey postponed.

extendedData.generalMeaning: News, freedom, messages from afar
extendedData.nearRim: Good news arriving very soon; a pleasant communication
extendedData.nearBase: News delayed; a journey or message still far off

entities.description: The bull in tea leaf reading symbolises formidable power that can be either an asset or an obstacle depending on orientation. Near the rim and facing the handle it points to a strong-willed helper or the querent's own determination carrying them through; turned away it signifies stubborn opposition, a quarrel, or a situation requiring great endurance. Near the base a bull suggests long-standing struggles that ultimately yield to persistence.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Power, stubbornness, opposition or strength
extendedData.nearRim: A powerful force at work; opposition or determination close at hand
extendedData.nearBase: Enduring struggle; strength accumulated over a long period

entities.description: The butterfly is universally linked to transformation, the soul, and the transience of pleasure across many cultures. In tasseomancy it most often signals a pleasant but passing social experience — enjoyment, flattery, or a flighty admirer who may not be serious. Near the rim it promises immediate delight and social success, though readers caution that the butterfly's nature is fickle; near the base it may indicate transformation in progress, an old self being shed for something new.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Transformation, pleasure, fickle nature
extendedData.nearRim: Social enjoyment, pleasant company, a flirtatious encounter
extendedData.nearBase: Deep transformation underway; shedding an old pattern

entities.description: The cat in tasseomancy traditionally warns of deceit, a false friend, or someone in the querent's circle who presents a pleasing face while concealing their true motives. Victorian tea-leaf manuals consistently linked the cat to treachery in domestic settings, particularly involving a woman. Near the rim it urges the querent to be watchful of a current acquaintance; near the base it suggests a past betrayal whose consequences are still working themselves out.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Deceit, a false friend, treachery
extendedData.nearRim: A deceptive person nearby; be cautious about trust
extendedData.nearBase: Past betrayal still influencing the situation

entities.description: The cow is one of the most benign animal symbols in tasseomancy, associated with agricultural prosperity, maternal nourishment, and steady abundance. It often signals that the querent's material needs will be well met and that patience in practical affairs will be rewarded. Near the rim it promises imminent prosperity and domestic comfort; near the base it suggests long-term security being quietly established.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Prosperity, abundance, material comfort
extendedData.nearRim: Good fortune in material matters; domestic contentment soon
extendedData.nearBase: Long-term abundance building steadily

entities.description: The crocodile is a symbol of lurking peril in tasseomancy — danger that hides beneath a calm surface and strikes without warning from an unexpected direction. It may represent a business rival who appears friendly, a hidden legal threat, or an emotional situation that conceals destructive potential. Near the rim it warns the querent to be on guard immediately; near the base it suggests old, unresolved dangers that have not fully passed.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Hidden danger, treachery from unexpected source
extendedData.nearRim: Immediate risk from a hidden enemy; stay alert
extendedData.nearBase: Old threats not yet fully neutralised

entities.description: The dog is one of the most consistently positive symbols in tasseomancy, representing faithfulness, loyal friendship, and steadfast support. A dog near the handle suggests a trusted companion or family member will offer important help; near the rim it promises that reliable friends are close and a matter of trust will be proved well-placed. Near the base a dog may indicate a loyal ally from the past, or a friendship that has weathered long separation.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Loyal friendship, faithful ally, trustworthy support
extendedData.nearRim: A true friend nearby; trust is well placed
extendedData.nearBase: A loyal bond from the past enduring; old friendship revisited

entities.description: The dove carries the oldest and most universal symbolism of peace, love, and the arrival of good tidings — a meaning that has passed intact into tasseomancy from classical and biblical tradition. Near the rim it promises an imminent message of peace or the happy resolution of a quarrel; near the handle it is closely connected to home and romantic happiness. Near the base a dove suggests that peace and reconciliation, though perhaps not immediate, are ultimately assured.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Peace, love, happy news, reconciliation
extendedData.nearRim: Peace and happy news arriving soon; a quarrel resolved
extendedData.nearBase: Peace ultimately assured though perhaps delayed

entities.description: The eagle is a symbol of high ambition, commanding power, and the achievement of difficult goals through sustained effort. In tasseomancy it traditionally indicates success in ventures requiring courage and vision, often pointing to advancement in career or public life. Near the rim it signals that the querent is positioned for significant achievement; near the base it indicates ambitions that must be built patiently from the ground up before they soar.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Ambition, power, high achievement, authority
extendedData.nearRim: Success in ambitious undertakings close at hand
extendedData.nearBase: Ambitions require sustained effort; the heights are reachable

entities.description: Fish are among the oldest luck symbols in human culture, and tasseomancy inherits this benevolent tradition fully — a fish in the cup is almost always welcomed as a sign of good fortune, fertility, and abundance. It frequently points to financial improvement, creative productivity, or a fruitful period generally. Near the rim it promises quick gains or a fortunate encounter; near the base it indicates deep, lasting prosperity or a significant birth — literal or metaphorical.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Good luck, fertility, abundance, financial gain
extendedData.nearRim: Imminent good fortune; financial or creative gains soon
extendedData.nearBase: Deep and lasting abundance; fertility or creative birth

entities.description: The fox in tasseomancy stands for cunning, slyness, and an enemy who uses intelligence and charm rather than force. It warns the querent to be alert to those who flatter while scheming, and to check business or personal dealings carefully for hidden manipulations. Near the rim it signals an active deceiver in the querent's immediate environment; near the base it may indicate a past deception whose full effects are still unfolding.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Cunning, deception, a scheming enemy
extendedData.nearRim: A clever deceiver actively at work nearby
extendedData.nearBase: Past deception still casting its shadow

entities.description: The frog symbolises transformation, fertility, and new beginnings, drawing on its life-cycle from tadpole to adult as a natural emblem of metamorphosis. In tasseomancy it is a broadly positive sign, indicating a change in circumstances that leads to growth — a new home, a career shift, or the start of a creative project. Near the rim it suggests this transformation is imminent; near the base it indicates a long-term regenerative process quietly underway.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Transformation, new beginning, fertility, change
extendedData.nearRim: A positive change or new start arriving soon
extendedData.nearBase: Long-term transformation building quietly

entities.description: The horse is a vigorous symbol of journey, travel, and the arrival of energetic assistance in tasseomancy. It may indicate a literal journey, or a swift forward movement in affairs that had been stalled. Near the handle it traditionally signifies a visitor coming to the home; near the rim it promises that progress is imminent and help is on its way; near the base it suggests travel or change still some distance in the future.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Journey, helpful visitor, swift progress
extendedData.nearRim: Rapid progress; a journey or energetic helper imminent
extendedData.nearBase: Travel or major change lies further ahead

entities.description: The lamb in tasseomancy represents innocence, gentleness, and often a young or vulnerable person who features in the querent's near future. It can signify a child, a naive friend, or a situation requiring gentle handling rather than force. Near the rim it suggests an innocent party or a gentle matter about to arise; near the base it may indicate the querent's own need to approach a situation with patience and softness.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Innocence, gentleness, a young person
extendedData.nearRim: A gentle or innocent matter arising; a young person nearby
extendedData.nearBase: The need for patience and a gentle approach

entities.description: The lion is the king of the animal kingdom and carries corresponding weight in tasseomancy, representing great power, influence, and a figure of authority whose favour or enmity will shape outcomes. Near the handle it suggests the querent themselves possesses or will acquire significant authority; near the rim it may indicate a powerful individual about to enter the picture. Near the base the lion speaks of power that is deeply rooted and must be reckoned with over the long term.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Power, authority, a dominant figure
extendedData.nearRim: A powerful person or force entering the situation
extendedData.nearBase: Long-standing power that must be acknowledged

entities.description: The mouse in tasseomancy is a symbol of small but persistent loss — money stolen by neglect, resources nibbled away by hidden problems, or timidity preventing bolder action. It may also warn of theft, whether literal or of time and opportunity. Near the rim it alerts the querent to current financial leakage or a timid approach undermining present efforts; near the base it points to a long-standing habit of self-limitation or a past theft whose effects persist.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Theft, petty loss, timidity, poverty
extendedData.nearRim: Small losses or timidity affecting current situation
extendedData.nearBase: Long-standing pattern of loss or self-limitation

entities.description: The owl occupies an ambiguous position in tasseomancy — in some traditions it is purely a bird of ill omen heralding scandal, illness, or misfortune; in others its association with Athena and wisdom redeems it as a warning to think carefully before acting. Most Victorian and Edwardian tea-leaf manuals treat it as a caution symbol. Near the rim it serves as an urgent warning about a current situation; near the base it may represent deep wisdom or a long-standing unheeded warning.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Warning, ill omen, wisdom ignored
extendedData.nearRim: A warning about current plans or behaviour; pay attention
extendedData.nearBase: A deep wisdom or old warning that was not heeded

entities.description: The rabbit is a widely positive symbol in tasseomancy, drawing on cross-cultural associations with luck, fertility, and abundance — from the European good-luck tradition to the Chinese lunar hare. It often appears when the querent is entering a productive and fortunate phase. Near the rim it promises swift good luck; near the base it signals deep potential for growth and fertility, whether in family, business, or creative work.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Good luck, abundance, fertility, quick gains
extendedData.nearRim: Swift good fortune; a lucky period beginning
extendedData.nearBase: Deep fertility and long-term abundance

entities.description: The rat in Western tasseomancy is unambiguously negative, pointing to treachery, rivals who undermine from behind the scenes, and the loss of resources or reputation through the actions of jealous others. It may also warn of unhygienic or dishonest conditions in a business or domestic environment. Near the rim it signals an active rival or betrayer at work right now; near the base it points to a long-running pattern of undermining that must be addressed.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Treachery, rivals, betrayal, loss through enemies
extendedData.nearRim: An active rival or traitor at work; be vigilant
extendedData.nearBase: Long-running treachery or undermining from the past

entities.description: The raven (or crow) brings ill tidings in Western tasseomancy, associated with bad news, misfortune, and in extreme interpretations with grief or bereavement. Its black plumage and carrion associations have made it a harbinger of darkness across European folk tradition. Near the rim it warns of bad news arriving quickly; near the base it may indicate a period of sorrow or loss that lies further in the future or is rooted in the past.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Bad news, misfortune, sorrow
extendedData.nearRim: Bad news arriving soon; a difficult event near at hand
extendedData.nearBase: A period of sorrow or loss in the deeper future or past

entities.description: The snake is the most contextually variable of all animal symbols in tasseomancy, carrying meanings that span healing, wisdom, and regeneration on one hand, and treachery, temptation, and hidden enemies on the other. In many traditions the coiled snake near the handle represents a wise counsellor; the snake in motion across the cup floor points to a cunning enemy. Near the rim it tends toward warning; near the base it is more likely to signify deep transformation or ancient wisdom.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Wisdom or treachery; healing or hidden enemy
extendedData.nearRim: A cunning enemy or deceptive situation nearby
extendedData.nearBase: Deep transformation or ancient wisdom at work

entities.description: The spider in tasseomancy is generally regarded as a fortunate sign, particularly when it appears to be weaving its web — an image of patient industry bringing its reward. It promises that hard work will be repaid and that persistence in a creative or commercial enterprise will yield results. Near the rim it signals that rewards for diligent effort are close; near the base it suggests that the foundations of long-term success are being quietly woven.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Industry rewarded, good fortune through hard work
extendedData.nearRim: Rewards for effort arriving soon; fortune favours the diligent
extendedData.nearBase: Patient industry building lasting success

entities.description: The wolf represents ravenous greed, predatory enemies, and an adversary who operates with pack cunning in tasseomancy. It warns against those who appear sociable but are motivated by self-interest and are willing to take what belongs to others. Near the rim it flags an active greedy or predatory individual in the querent's immediate sphere; near the base it points to a long-standing pattern of exploitation or an old enemy not yet fully dealt with.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Greed, a predatory enemy, exploitation
extendedData.nearRim: A greedy or predatory person active in current affairs
extendedData.nearBase: Long-standing exploitation or an old adversary

entities.description: The anchor is one of the most stable and positive symbols in tasseomancy. Near the rim it signals success in business or love; near the base it suggests a long voyage or a need for firm resolve. As a nautical symbol of hope and steadfastness, the anchor traditionally promises stability, safe harbour, and lasting foundations in whatever area of life it appears.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Stability, security, hope, a firm foundation
extendedData.nearRim: Success in business or love; good news coming
extendedData.nearBase: A long journey or the need for deep resolve

entities.description: The arrow in tasseomancy is a directional symbol whose meaning shifts sharply with orientation. Pointing upward it signals good news, ambition fulfilled, or a situation moving in the right direction; pointing downward it warns of bad news, a setback, or energy misdirected. Near the rim an upward arrow brings immediate positive news; a downward arrow near the rim urges the querent to change course quickly.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Direction, news — upward good, downward bad
extendedData.nearRim: Imminent news; direction critical — up means good, down means warning
extendedData.nearBase: Long-term direction being set; consider where aims are pointing

entities.description: The axe is a symbol of hard labour, obstacles that must be hewn through, and difficulties overcome by determined effort. In tasseomancy it rarely promises ease but consistently rewards fortitude — it tells the querent that the path ahead requires work rather than luck. Near the rim it indicates current difficulties requiring decisive action; near the base it points to a deeply rooted obstacle or a long-standing problem that demands confrontation.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Hard work, obstacles overcome through effort
extendedData.nearRim: Current difficulties requiring decisive action
extendedData.nearBase: A deep-rooted obstacle; persistence will ultimately clear it

entities.description: The basket in tasseomancy is an emblem of domestic abundance, gifts received, and the rewards of careful household management. A full-looking basket near the rim is a sign that a gift or pleasant domestic event is approaching; near the handle it connects directly to home and family life. Near the base a basket may indicate that domestic matters require more careful tending, or that a family gift or inheritance is a distant prospect.

extendedData.generalMeaning: A gift, domestic abundance, household rewards
extendedData.nearRim: A gift or pleasant domestic event arriving soon
extendedData.nearBase: A family matter or inheritance in the distant future

entities.description: The bell is one of the most joyful symbols in tasseomancy, ringing out good news, celebration, and significant announcements. One bell near the rim traditionally heralds a wedding, an engagement, or an important positive announcement; two bells magnify the joy. Near the base a bell may refer to news whose full meaning will only become clear in the distant future, or to an announcement that has its roots in past events.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Good news, celebration, a wedding or announcement
extendedData.nearRim: Joyful news or celebration imminent; a wedding or engagement likely
extendedData.nearBase: A significant announcement whose roots lie in the past

entities.description: The boat or ship in tasseomancy signifies a journey undertaken with assistance, the safe arrival of help, or the successful navigation of an emotional or practical voyage. Unlike the horse (which suggests land travel and swiftness), the boat implies a measured crossing of uncertain waters with a favourable outcome. Near the rim it promises safe passage and the arrival of needed resources or people; near the base it indicates a voyage still distant or the arrival of help from far away.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Safe journey, arrival of help, navigating uncertainty
extendedData.nearRim: Safe passage; help or resources arriving soon
extendedData.nearBase: A voyage or arrival of help from far away

entities.description: The book in tasseomancy promises the revelation of secrets, the acquisition of important knowledge, or a significant legal or official document. An open book suggests information freely given and truth coming to light; a closed book suggests knowledge withheld or a matter still to be uncovered. Near the rim it indicates that an important revelation or document will arrive very soon; near the base it may point to hidden information that has long affected events.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Secrets revealed, knowledge, official documents
extendedData.nearRim: An important revelation or document arriving very soon
extendedData.nearBase: Hidden knowledge; long-concealed information affecting events

entities.description: The bottle in tasseomancy carries warnings about excess — particularly around alcohol, pleasure, or self-indulgent spending — but can also be read as a symbol of stored abundance waiting to be opened. The reading depends heavily on context and position: near the rim it cautions against current over-indulgence; near the base it may represent either deep-seated addictive patterns or a legacy of stored goodness yet to be tapped. Some readers interpret a sealed bottle near the handle as a domestic secret.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Excess, caution about indulgence; also stored abundance
extendedData.nearRim: Current over-indulgence requiring moderation
extendedData.nearBase: A deep-seated pattern of excess or a stored resource

entities.description: The bridge in tasseomancy is a symbol of transition, the crossing from one phase of life to another, and the successful overcoming of obstacles that once seemed impassable. It indicates that the querent is at, or approaching, a crossing point — a decision that cannot be undone, a threshold that will change their circumstances. Near the rim it says the crossing is at hand; near the base it suggests a fundamental transition still some way off but inevitable.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Transition, crossing obstacles, a turning point
extendedData.nearRim: A significant threshold approaching; a crossing point imminent
extendedData.nearBase: A fundamental transition still ahead; prepare for change

entities.description: The candle illuminates darkness in both literal and metaphorical senses — in tasseomancy it stands for truth revealed, spiritual guidance, and the light of understanding brought to a confusing situation. It is also associated with sacred ceremony and the honouring of memory. Near the rim it promises that clarity is coming soon, and that a confusing matter will be illuminated; near the base it may indicate spiritual guidance coming from a deep or ancient source.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Illumination, truth revealed, spiritual guidance
extendedData.nearRim: Clarity arriving soon; a confusing matter becoming clear
extendedData.nearBase: Deep spiritual guidance; wisdom from an ancient or unconscious source

entities.description: The chain in tasseomancy represents binding commitment — which may be a happy marriage bond or an oppressive constraint, depending on other symbols in the cup and the question asked. A chain near the handle often predicts a marriage or serious partnership; near the rim it may warn of a binding obligation about to be entered. Near the base a chain suggests a long-standing bond or obligation that has shaped the querent's path for some time.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Commitment, marriage, also bondage or obligation
extendedData.nearRim: A binding commitment being entered; a partnership formalised
extendedData.nearBase: A long-standing bond or obligation shaping present events

entities.description: The clock introduces the theme of time into a tasseomancy reading — it may signal urgency, a deadline approaching, or, in older traditions, a warning about illness followed by recovery. Near the rim it urges the querent to act promptly on a current opportunity or obligation; near the base it may indicate a long-awaited event finally coming due. Some readers interpret the clock as specifically relating to health, predicting either the onset of illness or its resolution.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Time pressure, urgency, a deadline or recovery
extendedData.nearRim: Act now; a deadline or time-sensitive opportunity near at hand
extendedData.nearBase: A long-awaited event finally approaching; time of reckoning

entities.description: Clouds in tasseomancy represent doubt, uncertainty, and temporary obstacles that obscure the querent's vision or path. The number and density of clouds matters: a single light cloud near the rim indicates a minor uncertainty soon to clear; heavy, dark clouds suggest more serious confusion or hidden troubles ahead. Near the base clouds may represent deep-seated fears or old uncertainties still casting a shadow over present life.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Doubt, uncertainty, hidden troubles, obscured path
extendedData.nearRim: Temporary uncertainty or confusion affecting present plans
extendedData.nearBase: Deep-seated fears or old troubles still clouding matters

entities.description: The crown is one of the most powerful positive symbols in tasseomancy, promising honour, success, and the recognition of the querent's worth by others. It may indicate advancement to a position of authority, a public award, or the successful conclusion of a long struggle for status. Near the rim it signals that honour and recognition are very close; near the base it suggests that the seeds of future greatness are being laid, or that a deep aspiration to authority will eventually be fulfilled.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Honour, success, authority, public recognition
extendedData.nearRim: Recognition and honour arriving very soon
extendedData.nearBase: Future greatness in the making; ambitions for authority will be fulfilled

entities.description: The cup appearing within the tea cup is a gentle and benevolent symbol, representing love, emotional happiness, and the fulfilment of the heart's desires. It is particularly associated with romantic and domestic contentment. Near the rim it promises emotional joy and love relationships flourishing imminently; near the handle it emphasises the home as a source of happiness; near the base it may indicate a deep emotional fulfilment that will come to fruition over time.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Love, happiness, emotional fulfilment
extendedData.nearRim: Emotional joy and love arriving soon
extendedData.nearBase: Deep emotional fulfilment coming to fruition over time

entities.description: The flag in tasseomancy is primarily a warning symbol — a signal raised to draw attention to danger or the need for alertness. In military tradition the flag marks territory and signals intent; in tea reading it tells the querent to be watchful of their current position. Near the rim it urges immediate vigilance; near the base it suggests a warning from the past that should not be forgotten as new plans are made.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Warning, alert, danger signal
extendedData.nearRim: Immediate vigilance required; a danger flag raised
extendedData.nearBase: A past warning; do not forget the lessons already learned

entities.description: The fork in tasseomancy signals false friends and difficult choices — situations where the road divides and the querent cannot know which path leads to a good outcome, particularly when surrounded by those whose advice cannot be trusted. Near the rim it warns of a tricky decision or unreliable counsel very close at hand; near the base it points to a habitual pattern of indecision or a deep-seated mistrust that is shaping current events.

extendedData.generalMeaning: False friends, difficult choice, unreliable counsel
extendedData.nearRim: A difficult decision near; be wary of advice offered
extendedData.nearBase: A habitual pattern of indecision or mistrust

entities.description: The gate is a symbol of threshold and opportunity — a way through that is currently presenting itself to the querent. An open gate near the rim signals that a new path or significant opportunity is available right now and should not be delayed; a closed gate suggests obstacles to entry that must be addressed first. Near the base a gate indicates a long-sought opportunity finally becoming accessible.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Opportunity, a new path opening, a threshold
extendedData.nearRim: A significant opportunity available now; do not hesitate
extendedData.nearBase: A long-sought opening finally becoming accessible

entities.description: The gun is an unambiguously negative symbol in tasseomancy, pointing to conflict, quarrel, and the threat of sudden violent disruption to the querent's circumstances. It may indicate a legal battle, a heated argument with serious consequences, or in extreme readings a physical danger. Near the rim it warns of conflict that is imminent and may be unavoidable; near the base it suggests the lingering effects of a past conflict still poisoning present affairs.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Danger, quarrel, conflict, sudden disruption
extendedData.nearRim: Conflict or danger imminent; a serious quarrel approaching
extendedData.nearBase: Lingering effects of a past conflict

entities.description: The hammer in tasseomancy is the emblem of determined effort and practical construction — it tells the querent that the task ahead will not complete itself and that direct, sustained work is required. It is not a symbol of violence in this context but of honest craftsmanship and the will to build. Near the rim it says that now is the time to apply effort; near the base it indicates that a long-term project requiring persistent labour will ultimately succeed.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Hard work required, determination, practical construction
extendedData.nearRim: Now is the time to apply sustained effort
extendedData.nearBase: A long-term project requiring persistent labour; success through work

entities.description: The heart is the quintessential symbol of love and emotional joy in tasseomancy, and its appearance is almost always welcomed as a positive omen. Near the rim it promises romantic happiness and affection very close at hand; near the handle it speaks of love centred on the home and domestic life; near the base it indicates a love that is deeply rooted and enduring, or an emotional matter whose full expression lies in the future. Two hearts together are a traditional sign of an engagement or lasting partnership.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Love, joy, emotional happiness, romance
extendedData.nearRim: Romantic happiness or affection arriving very soon
extendedData.nearBase: Deep and enduring love; an emotional matter coming to full expression

entities.description: The horseshoe is one of the most universally recognised good-luck symbols in Western folk tradition, and tasseomancy assigns it the same meaning — protection, fortune, and the blessing of unexpected positive turns. It is considered especially powerful when it appears with the open end facing the handle, directing luck toward the querent's home. Near the rim it signals good fortune arriving very soon; near the base it promises a deep and lasting protection over affairs.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Good luck, protection, fortunate turns
extendedData.nearRim: Good fortune arriving very soon; a lucky period beginning
extendedData.nearBase: Deep and lasting protection and good fortune

entities.description: The house in tasseomancy is a strongly domestic symbol, pointing to security, family life, and the conditions of the home. Near the rim it promises stability and domestic happiness about to be established or improved; near the handle it emphasises current domestic conditions as especially significant for the question at hand. Near the base a house suggests that the foundations of long-term security are being laid, or indicates a matter connected to an ancestral home or family legacy.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Security, domestic happiness, family life
extendedData.nearRim: Domestic stability or a new home arriving soon
extendedData.nearBase: Long-term security being established; ancestral or family matters

entities.description: The key in tasseomancy is a symbol of mysteries solved, doors opened, and new knowledge that unlocks previously inaccessible opportunities. It is almost always a positive sign, suggesting that an answer the querent has been seeking is about to be provided, or that an opportunity previously closed to them is opening. Near the rim it signals an imminent revelation or opening; near the base it indicates deep knowledge or a long-held secret finally coming to light.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Mystery solved, opportunity unlocked, new knowledge
extendedData.nearRim: A revelation or new opening imminent
extendedData.nearBase: A deep secret or long-held knowledge coming to light

entities.description: The knife in tasseomancy carries sharp and largely negative associations — conflict, separation, the severing of relationships, and betrayal. A knife pointing toward the handle may suggest a domestic quarrel or the ending of a close relationship; pointing away it may indicate the querent cutting free from something harmful. Near the rim it warns of an imminent painful separation or conflict; near the base it speaks of an old wound or severing that still affects present circumstances.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Conflict, separation, betrayal, severing
extendedData.nearRim: An imminent separation or painful conflict
extendedData.nearBase: An old wound or past severance still affecting the present

entities.description: The cross is one of the most context-dependent symbols in tasseomancy, carrying meanings of both suffering and faith, trial and spiritual protection. Near the rim it may signal a coming period of difficulty or sacrifice; near the handle it often points to a burden carried within the home. In some traditions the cross also represents a crossroads — a decisive moment requiring a spiritual or ethical choice — and its proximity to other symbols significantly colours its meaning.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Suffering, faith, a trial, spiritual protection
extendedData.nearRim: A coming difficulty or sacrifice requiring faith
extendedData.nearBase: A deep spiritual trial; foundational beliefs being tested

entities.description: A diamond shape in the tea leaves points to wealth, valuable gifts, and the clarity of vision that comes from seeing situations in their true worth. It may indicate financial success, a valuable transaction, or the receipt of a precious gift — whether material or of knowledge. Near the rim it promises wealth or a valuable acquisition close at hand; near the base it suggests deep material potential or a legacy connected to wealth.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Wealth, clarity, a valuable gift or opportunity
extendedData.nearRim: Financial success or a valuable acquisition coming soon
extendedData.nearBase: Deep material potential; a legacy or long-term wealth

entities.description: Flames or fire shapes in tasseomancy represent intense passion, creative energy, and transformative force — but also warn of dangerous overreaching or heated conflict. Near the rim they signal passion, urgency, or a heated situation requiring immediate care; near the handle they connect to domestic arguments or passionate relationships at home. Near the base fire suggests a deep creative or destructive force long at work in the querent's life, demanding conscious direction.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Passion, energy, transformation, also danger
extendedData.nearRim: Intense passion or urgency; a heated situation requiring care
extendedData.nearBase: A deep transformative or destructive force requiring direction

entities.description: The flower is a reliably positive symbol in tasseomancy, representing happiness, beauty, love, and the receipt of a sincere compliment or admiring attention. Near the rim it promises a pleasant social encounter or romantic appreciation very soon; near the handle it suggests blooming domestic happiness. Near the base a flower indicates that the seeds of happiness have been planted and are growing slowly toward a joyful expression.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Happiness, beauty, love, a compliment or admiration
extendedData.nearRim: Pleasant social or romantic appreciation arriving soon
extendedData.nearBase: Happiness growing slowly; joy in the making

entities.description: A forest or cluster of trees in the tea leaves represents a complex, tangled situation where the path forward is unclear — the proverbial difficulty of not seeing the wood for the trees. It may also indicate a crowded social situation, opposing interests, or obstacles that multiply and interlock. Near the rim it warns of confusion and complications in present circumstances; near the base it points to deep-rooted complexity or ancestral patterns creating difficulty.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Confusion, tangled circumstances, obstacles multiplying
extendedData.nearRim: Present confusion or a complicated situation requiring clarity
extendedData.nearBase: Deep-rooted complexity or ancestral patterns at play

entities.description: Grapes in tasseomancy carry classical associations with abundance, Bacchanalian celebration, and the rich rewards of harvest. They are a strongly positive symbol pointing to a successful completion of effort, celebratory events, and the enjoyment of well-earned prosperity. Near the rim they promise imminent celebration and abundance; near the base they indicate a deeply satisfying harvest of long-term work, or a celebration connected to a significant life milestone.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Abundance, celebration, the rewards of harvest
extendedData.nearRim: Celebration and abundance arriving soon
extendedData.nearBase: Long-term harvest being reaped; a major life celebration

entities.description: A single leaf or small cluster of leaves is a charming good-luck symbol in tasseomancy, pointing to new growth, good news of a modest kind, and the quiet unfolding of positive circumstances. Unlike the dramatic good fortune of the fish or horseshoe, the leaf promises gradual, organic improvement — things growing naturally in the right direction. Near the rim it signals small good news or a new beginning; near the base it indicates the slow, steady growth of something important.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Good luck, new growth, gradual improvement
extendedData.nearRim: Small good news or the start of a new growth
extendedData.nearBase: Slow, steady growth of something important

entities.description: The lightning bolt in tasseomancy represents sudden, dramatic change — a revelation, shock, or disruption that arrives without warning and transforms the situation irrevocably. It may be positive (a sudden breakthrough) or negative (an unexpected crisis), and context from surrounding symbols is essential. Near the rim it warns of a sudden change or revelation imminent; near the base it indicates that a dramatic transformation is rooted in deeper forces already in motion.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Sudden change, shock, revelation
extendedData.nearRim: A sudden dramatic change or revelation imminent
extendedData.nearBase: A dramatic transformation rooted in deep forces

entities.description: The moon in tasseomancy governs the realm of intuition, dreams, romance, and hidden emotional currents. A full or prominent moon is broadly positive, signifying heightened intuition and romantic opportunity; a crescent often suggests new beginnings or that a matter is in its early, waxing phase. Near the rim the moon promises romance or an intuitive breakthrough soon; near the base it suggests deep psychic or emotional currents that quietly drive present events.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Intuition, romance, hidden emotional currents
extendedData.nearRim: Romantic opportunity or intuitive breakthrough approaching
extendedData.nearBase: Deep psychic and emotional currents shaping events

entities.description: The mountain in tasseomancy presents the greatest of obstacles — a challenge of formidable scale that will require extraordinary effort to overcome, but which can indeed be overcome. It is not a symbol of defeat but of the magnitude of the work ahead. Near the rim it warns of a great obstacle currently blocking progress; near the base it suggests an enormous challenge that lies further in the future, or that the querent's deepest ambitions require mountainous effort to realise.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Great obstacle, also great achievement through effort
extendedData.nearRim: A major obstacle currently blocking progress
extendedData.nearBase: An enormous challenge ahead; a great ambition requiring extraordinary effort

entities.description: The rainbow is one of the most hopeful symbols in all of tasseomancy, traditionally appearing after a period of difficulty to promise that the storm has passed and better times are at hand. It bridges sky and earth, suggesting that high hopes and practical reality are being reconciled. Near the rim it promises that a difficult period is ending very soon; near the base it offers long-term reassurance that hope and positive outcomes are eventually assured.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Hope after trouble, better times ahead
extendedData.nearRim: A difficult period ending; good times approaching very soon
extendedData.nearBase: Long-term assurance that positive outcomes are coming

entities.description: The ring is a symbol of completeness, wholeness, and enduring commitment in tasseomancy. Near the rim it traditionally predicts a forthcoming marriage or the sealing of a significant partnership; near the handle it connects the commitment to home and family. A complete, unbroken ring is extremely positive; a broken ring near the rim warns of a quarrel or separation in a relationship. Near the base a ring indicates a long-standing bond or a completion that is building toward its fulfilment.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Commitment, marriage, completion, wholeness
extendedData.nearRim: A marriage or major partnership commitment approaching
extendedData.nearBase: A long-standing bond building toward its completion

entities.description: The rose is the pre-eminent symbol of love, beauty, and romantic success across Western divination traditions, and tasseomancy is no exception. Its appearance is considered a highly auspicious sign for matters of the heart and for creative or social endeavours where beauty and grace matter. Near the rim it promises a beautiful romance or social success very close at hand; near the base it indicates a deep and enduring love, or a beauty that is slowly coming into full bloom.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Love, beauty, romantic success
extendedData.nearRim: A beautiful romance or social success imminent
extendedData.nearBase: A deep and enduring love slowly coming into full bloom

entities.description: The shooting star in tasseomancy carries the folk-magic tradition of wishing upon a falling star into the cup, promising that a heartfelt wish will be granted or that sudden unexpected good fortune is on its way. It is a symbol of the extraordinary, suggesting an event that lifts circumstances above the ordinary in a flash. Near the rim it promises sudden good luck very soon; near the base it suggests that a long-held wish is beginning its arc toward fulfilment.

extendedData.generalMeaning: A wish granted, sudden unexpected good fortune
extendedData.nearRim: Sudden good luck or a granted wish arriving very soon
extendedData.nearBase: A long-held wish beginning its arc toward fulfilment

entities.description: The star is a symbol of hope, divine guidance, and spiritual aspiration in tasseomancy, drawing on the universal human tradition of navigation by the fixed stars. A five-pointed star is especially auspicious, pointing to inspiration and spiritual protection; multiple stars scattered through the cup indicate a generally fortunate period. Near the rim a star promises guidance and hope close at hand; near the base it speaks of a deep spiritual calling or a guiding purpose that shapes the querent's destiny.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Hope, guidance, spiritual insight, aspiration
extendedData.nearRim: Guidance and hope close at hand; inspired direction
extendedData.nearBase: A deep spiritual calling or guiding purpose

entities.description: The sun is among the most powerfully positive symbols in the entire tasseomancy lexicon, promising happiness, vitality, power, and outstanding success in whatever matter is at the forefront of the querent's concerns. Its warmth and light dispel confusion and opposition alike. Near the rim it signals that a period of great happiness and success is about to begin; near the base it promises that deep, lasting vitality and life success are in the querent's fundamental nature.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Happiness, power, outstanding success, vitality
extendedData.nearRim: A period of great happiness and success beginning very soon
extendedData.nearBase: Deep, lasting vitality and life success

entities.description: A single tree in tasseomancy represents strength, family roots, and the fulfilment of ambitions through steady growth. It is a symbol of living potential — slow to grow, but enduring. Near the rim it promises that ambitions will flourish and family connections will strengthen; near the handle it specifically connects to family life and domestic roots. Near the base a tree indicates very deep roots — ancestral matters, long-held ambitions, or a strength that has been building for years.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Strength, family roots, ambitions fulfilled through growth
extendedData.nearRim: Ambitions flourishing; family bonds strengthening
extendedData.nearBase: Very deep roots; ancestral strength and long-held ambitions

entities.description: The umbrella in tasseomancy is a symbol of protection and shelter — someone or something providing a shield against life's difficulties. An open umbrella is more protective than a closed one. Near the rim it suggests that help and protection are available right now and should be accepted; near the base it may indicate a long-standing protection the querent has relied on without fully appreciating, or a shelter being built for the future.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Protection, shelter from trouble, a helpful guardian
extendedData.nearRim: Protection available now; accept the help being offered
extendedData.nearBase: Long-standing protection; a shelter being built for the future

entities.description: Waves in tasseomancy represent emotional turbulence, change, and the powerful movement of circumstances beyond the querent's direct control. A single wave may signal a change of emotional mood or circumstances; a series of waves indicates ongoing upheaval. Near the rim they warn of emotional turbulence or change very soon; near the base they point to deep emotional currents or cycles of change that are fundamental to the querent's life pattern.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Emotional turbulence, change, forces beyond direct control
extendedData.nearRim: Emotional upheaval or significant change imminent
extendedData.nearBase: Deep emotional cycles; fundamental life changes

entities.description: Individual letters appearing in tea leaves traditionally point to the initial of a significant person's name — a person who will play a role in the events indicated by surrounding symbols. The letter A, as the first letter of the alphabet, carries additional connotations of beginnings and primary importance. Near the rim it indicates this significant person is nearby or will appear soon; near the base it may indicate a person from the past whose influence is still felt.

extendedData.generalMeaning: An important initial; a person whose name begins with A
extendedData.nearRim: A significant person with this initial entering the querent's life soon
extendedData.nearBase: A person from the past with this initial still influencing events

entities.description: The number three has been considered auspicious and magically significant across virtually every human culture, from the triple goddess to the Christian Trinity. In tasseomancy it signals luck, creativity, and a significant third event or person that resolves or transforms the situation. Near the rim it promises a lucky third occurrence very soon; near the base it suggests that a significant threefold pattern is at work in the querent's life at a deep level.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Luck, creativity, a significant third event
extendedData.nearRim: Lucky third occurrence or creative breakthrough very soon
extendedData.nearBase: A deep threefold pattern at work in the querent's life

entities.description: Seven is the number of spiritual completion and good fortune across Western, Middle Eastern, and Asian traditions alike, from the seven days of creation to the seven chakras. In tasseomancy it is one of the most strongly positive numbers, indicating that events are spiritually aligned, that the querent's path is cosmically supported, and that good fortune is accumulating. Near the rim it signals a fortunate phase beginning; near the base it suggests the querent's life is built on spiritually sound foundations.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Good fortune, spiritual significance, cosmic alignment
extendedData.nearRim: A fortunate and spiritually supported phase beginning
extendedData.nearBase: Life built on spiritually sound foundations

entities.description: Eight is the number of material success, worldly power, and the principle of as above, so below — its shape an infinity symbol standing upright. In tasseomancy it promises concrete achievement in business and material life, and may also indicate that cycles of effort are completing in the querent's favour. Near the rim it signals material success and achievement arriving soon; near the base it indicates a deep capacity for material success that is steadily building.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Material success, worldly power, cycles completing
extendedData.nearRim: Material success and business achievement arriving soon
extendedData.nearBase: A deep capacity for material success steadily building

entities.description: Thirteen is the most ambiguous number in tasseomancy, carrying the Western folk association with bad luck and misfortune on one hand, and the older esoteric tradition of thirteen as a number of spiritual transformation and the cycle of lunar months on the other. Its meaning is heavily context-dependent: surrounded by negative symbols it amplifies misfortune; surrounded by positive symbols it may indicate a powerful spiritual transformation. Near the rim it urges particular care; near the base it suggests deep karmic patterns in motion.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Traditional bad luck or powerful spiritual transformation
extendedData.nearRim: Particular care advised; a tricky situation or a test
extendedData.nearBase: Deep karmic or transformative patterns in motion

entities.description: The angel in tasseomancy is among the most powerfully benevolent symbols available, representing divine protection, blessings from a higher source, and good news of a deeply reassuring kind. Its appearance suggests that the querent is watched over and that a favourable outcome has a spiritual guarantee behind it. Near the rim it promises divine blessings and protective good news arriving very soon; near the base it indicates a fundamental spiritual protection underlying all the querent's affairs.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Divine protection, blessings, deeply reassuring good news
extendedData.nearRim: Divine blessings and protection very close at hand
extendedData.nearBase: A fundamental spiritual protection underlying all affairs

entities.description: The baby in tasseomancy most directly indicates new beginnings — often a literal pregnancy or birth, but also the birth of a project, creative work, or new phase of life that is entirely fresh and full of potential. It is a consistently positive symbol of innocent new starts. Near the rim it suggests a new beginning or birth arriving very soon; near the base it indicates a new beginning whose roots are being quietly laid, or a birth of deep personal significance.

extendedData.generalMeaning: New beginning, a birth, innocent fresh start
extendedData.nearRim: A birth or new beginning arriving very soon
extendedData.nearBase: A new beginning whose foundations are being quietly laid

entities.description: The child figure in tasseomancy represents joy, innocence, and the presence or influence of a young person in the querent's affairs. It may indicate a child in the querent's life, a childlike quality needed in a situation, or a new and inexperienced venture requiring nurturing. Near the rim it suggests a young person or childlike new beginning very close at hand; near the base it indicates a youthful energy or a child's influence that has deep roots in the querent's history.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Joy, innocence, a young person or new start
extendedData.nearRim: A young person or innocent new beginning nearby
extendedData.nearBase: A youthful energy or child's influence rooted in the past

entities.description: The coffin is one of the most startling symbols in tasseomancy but is rarely read as literal death — rather it signifies the ending of a phase, the completion of a chapter, and the transformation that follows a significant conclusion. Victorian readers consistently interpreted it as illness or the end of a problematic situation rather than bereavement. Near the rim it warns of an ending or significant closure very close; near the base it indicates a deep transformation or long-running ending finally completing.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Ending of a phase, transformation, closure
extendedData.nearRim: A significant ending or closure very close at hand
extendedData.nearBase: A deep transformation or long-running ending completing

entities.description: The dancer figure in tasseomancy embodies celebration, joy, and the expression of life's pleasurable aspects — though some readers caution that a single dancer may suggest frivolity or a distraction from serious matters. Near the rim it promises festivities, social pleasure, and celebration very soon; near the base it may indicate either a deep capacity for joy that needs expression, or a pattern of avoiding serious matters through distraction.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Celebration, joy, social pleasure, also frivolity
extendedData.nearRim: Festivities and social pleasure arriving very soon
extendedData.nearBase: A deep capacity for joy; or a pattern of joyful avoidance

entities.description: The devil figure in tasseomancy represents temptation, a bad influence in the querent's environment, or the querent's own shadow — the darker impulses, compulsions, or self-destructive patterns that undermine higher intentions. It is one of the more serious warning symbols. Near the rim it alerts the querent to an active temptation or bad influence close at hand; near the base it indicates deep-seated shadow patterns or long-standing bad influences that must be consciously addressed.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Temptation, bad influence, shadow self
extendedData.nearRim: An active temptation or bad influence close at hand
extendedData.nearBase: Deep shadow patterns or long-standing negative influences

entities.description: The ghost in tasseomancy signals that the past is returning — unresolved issues, people or situations the querent thought were finished, or emotional patterns that have not been fully laid to rest. Near the rim it indicates that something from the past is actively impinging on present circumstances and must be acknowledged; near the base it suggests very deep, perhaps unconscious, past influences that are the hidden architects of current events.

extendedData.generalMeaning: The past returning, unresolved issues, hidden influences
extendedData.nearRim: A past matter actively impinging on the present
extendedData.nearBase: Deep, perhaps unconscious, past influences shaping current events

entities.description: A generic human figure in the tea leaves most commonly indicates that an important person is about to enter or significantly influence the querent's life. The figure's posture, the direction it faces relative to the handle, and surrounding symbols all contribute to identifying this person's role. Near the rim the person is entering imminently; near the base it suggests a significant individual whose influence, perhaps not yet apparent, is deep and long-lasting.

extendedData.generalMeaning: An important person entering or influencing the querent's life
extendedData.nearRim: A significant person entering the situation very soon
extendedData.nearBase: A person whose deep and lasting influence is not yet fully apparent

entities.description: The witch figure in tasseomancy represents hidden power, magical thinking, and cunning intelligence — qualities that may be turned for or against the querent. In some readings it points to a wise woman or magician who can provide esoteric guidance; in others it warns of someone using hidden means to influence the querent's circumstances. Near the rim it suggests magical or hidden forces actively at play right now; near the base it indicates deep occult patterns underlying current events.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Hidden power, magical influence, cunning intelligence
extendedData.nearRim: Hidden or magical forces actively at play
extendedData.nearBase: Deep occult patterns underlying current events

entities.description: A clear circle in the tea leaves is a symbol of wholeness, completion, and the gift of fulfillment — it represents a matter coming full cycle and finding its natural resolution. In some traditions a circle near the top of the cup signals a valuable gift or sum of money on its way; near the handle it may represent the completion of a domestic or family matter. Near the base a circle suggests a completion of deep significance, a cycle in the querent's life reaching its natural end.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Completion, wholeness, a gift, a cycle fulfilled
extendedData.nearRim: A matter completing or a gift arriving very soon
extendedData.nearBase: A significant life cycle reaching its natural resolution

entities.description: A cluster of small dots scattered through the tea leaves is a traditional sign of money — small, unexpected financial gains arriving from multiple sources. The denser the cluster and the higher in the cup, the sooner and more significant the financial benefit. Near the rim dots promise imminent small windfalls; near the base they suggest money accumulating slowly through multiple small channels over a longer period.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Money, small unexpected gains, financial accumulation
extendedData.nearRim: Imminent small financial windfalls from multiple sources
extendedData.nearBase: Money accumulating steadily through many small channels

entities.description: The ladder in tasseomancy is the emblem of ambition, advancement, and the step-by-step ascent toward higher status or spiritual development. It may indicate a promotion, a rise in social standing, or spiritual aspiration being rewarded by steady progress. Near the rim it promises a promotion or notable advancement very soon; near the base it indicates that the foundations for an ambitious ascent are being built, rung by patient rung.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Ambition, promotion, step-by-step advancement
extendedData.nearRim: Promotion or social advancement arriving very soon
extendedData.nearBase: Ambitious foundations being carefully built

entities.description: The question mark is a self-referential symbol in tasseomancy — it appears when the reading itself is uncertain, when the querent's own indecision is the central issue, or when important information has not yet come to light. It does not predict a bad outcome but urges patience and the gathering of more facts before acting. Near the rim it signals current uncertainty that must be resolved soon; near the base it points to a deep, fundamental uncertainty or unanswered question at the core of the querent's situation.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Uncertainty, an unanswered question, wait for more information
extendedData.nearRim: Current uncertainty to be resolved; gather more facts before acting
extendedData.nearBase: A deep fundamental question unanswered at the core of affairs

entities.description: The spiral is one of the oldest symbols of evolution, spiritual growth, and the cyclical movement of time in human art. In tasseomancy it indicates that matters are moving — either inward toward a centre of truth and self-knowledge, or outward toward greater expression and impact in the world. The direction matters: an inward spiral suggests introspection; an outward one suggests expansion. Near the rim it signals an important evolution very soon; near the base it points to a profound, long-running evolutionary process.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Evolution, spiritual growth, things moving inward or outward
extendedData.nearRim: An important personal evolution beginning very soon
extendedData.nearBase: A profound and long-running evolutionary process at work

entities.description: The square in tasseomancy embodies solid material foundations and the principle of stability, but may also indicate restriction or confinement — the box of obligations, habits, or circumstances that limits freedom. Near the rim a square suggests that stability is being established or that the querent is operating within restrictive conditions right now; near the base it indicates either very deep foundations of security or a long-standing limitation that requires conscious examination.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Stability, solid foundation, also restriction
extendedData.nearRim: Stability being established or a current restriction to navigate
extendedData.nearBase: Very deep foundations or a long-standing limitation

entities.description: The triangle in tasseomancy changes its entire meaning with orientation — pointing upward it is a symbol of ascent, success, and positive ambition, the fire triangle of alchemy rising toward spirit; pointing downward it suggests conflict, instability, and plans undermined. Near the rim the orientation is particularly important as its meaning will manifest very soon; near the base the triangle speaks of deep structural dynamics — upward pointing to foundational success, downward to deep-rooted conflict.

extendedData.generalMeaning: Success if pointing up; conflict if pointing down
extendedData.nearRim: Success or conflict imminent — orientation is critical
extendedData.nearBase: Deep structural success or conflict; foundational dynamics
